info.description: Complete API collection generated from the Express routes under app/routes. Set apiBaseUrl to your server URL and run Users > POST /login with loginEmail/loginPassword. The login test automatically saves the returned token to the collection variable; all other requests inherit Bearer Token authentication from the collection. CRUD write requests use a TODO JSON template that must be replaced with fields expected by each controller.
